title: Calcutta High Court Directs Police To Protect TMC's Martyrs' Day Venue, Seeks Report On Alleged Vandalism Despite Earlier Order
description: The Calcutta High Court on Monday directed the Kolkata Police to provide protection for dismantling and removing materials from the venue of a Martyrs' Day programme after allegations that the site was vandalised despite an earlier court order directing adequate police protection for the event. Justice Saugata Bhattacharyya also called for a report from the Joint Commissioner of Police detailing the steps taken to implement the Court's earlier directions.
